plugin.name: Corinthians
plugin.description:
About the Mod
This mod makes followers much harder to detect while the player is sneaking or invisible.
Followers receive temporary stealth bonuses and, while the player is invisible, they will not affect the player's stealth meter.
All changes are automatically reverted when stealth is no longer active.
The goal is simple: your followers should not ruin your stealth gameplay.
VAI CORINTHIANS

plugin.name: Install DLL
plugin.description: DLL version 6.4.0: improves stealth behavior for followers and allied summons/reanimated actors. Allied summons cannot attack or cast while the player remains undetected and out of combat, with Aggression and Assistance temporarily suppressed. Combat is unlocked on detection or combat initiation, with event-assisted tracking of the ongoing encounter. Requires a compatible SKSE and Address Library.
